This folder contains the unmodified Parser.js and utils/Utf8Stream.js from
stream-json 1.9.1 by Eugene Lazutkin, distributed under the BSD-3-Clause
license in LICENSE. These two components use only built-in Node modules;
the rest of the stream-json package and its optional pipeline helpers are
not needed for SpaceLens snapshot imports.

Upstream: https://github.com/uhop/stream-json
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/stream-json/v/1.9.1
